title: Ep 22 — Anthropic teaches Claude to run lab equipment, and the AI-visibility tracker that sold for eighty-five thousand dollars in nine days
description: Anthropic opens a research preview letting Claude safely operate physical lab and robotic equipment through one shared driver standard, Google ships production-ready speech-to-text and text-to-video models, and Cursor and Lovable both loosen how their coding agents get built. Plus a deep dive on AI answer-engine visibility monitoring, the GEO tool that took solo builder Yogesh from five hundred dollars a month to an eighty-five-thousand-dollar sale in nine days, niched for Steve's audience as a visibility audit for LeaguePages' grassroots clubs and PlayFundWin's fundraising pitch, and why this week's Department for Transport charging-point statistics still hadn't surfaced for EV-Partnerships.
